project_type: Python FastAPI monorepo (api + worker + shared package) + Next.js 16 App Router dashboard
build_system: Hatchling (Python packages), Next.js 16 (dashboard). Python packages use editable installs via pyproject.toml. No top-level Makefile.
test_framework: pytest (api: api/tests/test_api.py, worker: worker/tests/test_worker.py). Dashboard: no test suite configured — use `npm run build` for TypeScript validation.
test_command: cd api && python -m pytest tests/ -x   ||   cd worker && python -m pytest tests/ -x
verification_instructions: 1. Run `cd packages/synthetiq-shared && python -c "from synthetiq_shared.schemas import SalesLine; print('OK')"`. 2. Run `cd packages/synthetiq-shared && alembic upgrade head && alembic current`. 3. Run `cd api && python -m pytest tests/ -x`. 4. Run `cd worker && python -m pytest tests/ -x`. 5. Run `cd dashboard && npm run build`.
environment_constraints: Alembic RLS statements must be wrapped in try/except for SQLite dev compatibility (see phase2 migration pattern). Never drop connection_config column in this phase. Phase 3 table queries in preflight must use try/except. Dashboard: read node_modules/next/dist/docs/ before writing any Next.js code — version 16.3.7 has breaking changes.
contribution_requirements: dashboard/AGENTS.md: This is NOT the Next.js you know — read node_modules/next/dist/docs/ before writing code. All interactive dashboard components must have 'use client' directive. MUI v5 for all UI components. BaseService/request<T> pattern for all typed API calls; use raw fetch for multipart uploads.
key_patterns: 1. Alembic migrations: revision chain c1d2e3f4a5b6 -> new d4e5f6a7b8c9; wrap RLS in try/except; see packages/synthetiq-shared/alembic/versions/c1d2e3f4a5b6_phase2_runs.py for exact pattern. 2. ORM: SQLAlchemy mapped_column with Mapped[] types; all tenant tables have org_id FK to organizations.org_id. 3. API routes: FastAPI APIRouter; TenantCtx from src/utils/tenant.py; assert_same_org from src/middleware/rbac.py; require_permission('perm:name') dependency. 4. Connector: DataConnector ABC in worker/src/services/data_connector.py; shim in api/src/services/data_connector_shim.py re-exports same symbols. 5. Dashboard: useSession() provides {user, token}; API_BASE const at top of each page; MUI Box/Card/Dialog/Table pattern; no Redux, no SWR — plain useState+useCallback+useEffect.
directory_structure: c:\Users\HP\SynthetIQ\ — root. api/ — FastAPI app (src/routes/, src/services/, src/middleware/, src/utils/, tests/). worker/ — Temporal worker (src/activities/, src/flows/, src/services/, tests/). packages/synthetiq-shared/ — shared ORM models, Alembic migrations, Pydantic configs (synthetiq_shared/models/, synthetiq_shared/utils/, alembic/versions/). dashboard/ — Next.js 16 App Router (app/ with page.tsx files per route, app/lib/services/, app/lib/types/, app/lib/contexts/). .agents/tasks/ — planning artifacts (never committed to git).
